title_en: Steam Sale Survival Guide 2026: When to Buy & How to Stack Discounts
title_zh: Steam 大促生存指南 2026：什么时候买 & 如何叠加折扣
excerpt_en: The complete Steam Sale playbook for 2026 — every seasonal sale date, how deep discounts go, when to buy vs wait, and the stacking tricks (wishlists, refunds, bundle sites, regional pricing) that squeeze PC game prices to their floor.
excerpt_zh: 2026 年 Steam 大促完整攻略——每个季节大促日期、折扣到底有多深、什么时候该买什么时候该等，以及把 PC 游戏价格压到地板价的叠加技巧（心愿单、退款、捆绑站、跨区定价）。

title_en: Free Games to Claim Right Now — August 2026
title_zh: 现在就能领取的免费游戏 — 2026 年 8 月
excerpt_en: Every free game you can claim in August 2026 across Epic Games Store, PlayStation Plus, Xbox, and Nintendo eShop. Don't miss these free giveaways — updated with expiry dates and how to grab them.
excerpt_zh: 2026 年 8 月你可以在 Epic、PS Plus、Xbox 和 eShop 上领取的所有免费游戏汇总。别错过这些限时免费领取——附到期时间和领取方法。

title_zh: 2026 全球游戏优惠终极攻略
excerpt_en: From eShop region-switching to PSN sale timing, Steam seasonal sales to Game Pass deals — the complete playbook for buying cheap Switch, PS5 & Xbox games across every platform, worldwide.
excerpt_zh: 从 eShop 跨区购买到 PSN 打折节奏，从 Steam 季节大促到 Game Pass 优惠——全平台范围内以最低价购买 Switch、PS5 和 Xbox 游戏的完整攻略。
